novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new training-time measurement-and-control coupling: a "held-out 'canary'" internal harmfulness signal is used to provide "early-warning of impending alignment collapse" and trigger a "drift-velocity-gated activation-anchoring intervention." Searches as of 2026-08-26 for "LLM fine-tuning safety online activation drift monitoring," "alignment collapse early warning canary probes optimizer steps," and "dynamic safety shaping gated intervention" found the closest work to be Shape it Up! Restoring LLM Safety during Finetuning (2025), which dynamically shapes updates using token-level guardrail signals, alongside Navigating the Safety Landscape (2024), LARF (2025), and Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction (2024), but none couples stepwise internal trajectory forecasting to conditional correction. The step from those works is a substantive multi-step integration and change in temporal unit of analysis, but still a natural extension combining established refusal directions, drift monitoring, KL anchoring, and adaptive regularization rather than a new core mechanistic principle.
